verses.geez: ወጸውዖ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ወባረኮ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ኢትንሣእ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እምአዋልደ ፡ ከናአን ።
verses.translation: And Isaac having called for Jacob, blessed him, and charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites.

translations.lxx: And Isaac having called for Jacob, blessed him, and charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites.
translations.kjv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
translations.ron: Atunci a chemat Isaac pe Iacov şi l-a binecuvântat şi i-a poruncit, zicând: "Să nu-ţi iei femeie din fetele Canaaneilor;
translations.grk: Προσκαλεσάμενος δὲ Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακὼβ, εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ, λέγων, οὐ λήψῃ γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων.

verses.geez:
ተንሥእ ፡ ወሑር ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ባቱኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ [አቡ]ሃ ፡ ለእምከ ፡ ወንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡
                  ብእሲተ ፡ እምአዋልዲሁ ፡ ለላባ ፡ እኁሃ ፡ ለእምከ ።
verses.translation: Rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia, to the house of Bathuel the father of thy mother, and take to thyself thence a wife of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

translations.lxx: Rise and depart quickly into Mesopotamia, to the house of Bathuel the father of thy mother, and take to thyself thence a wife of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.
translations.kjv: Arise, go to Padanaram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.
translations.ron: Ci scoală şi mergi în Mesopotamia în casa lui Batuel, tatăl mamei tale, şi-ţi ia femeie de acolo, din fetele lui Laban, fratele mamei tale,
translations.grk: Ἀναστὰς ἀπόδραθι εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν, εἰς τὸν οἶκον Βαθουὴλ τοῦ πατρὸς τῆς μητρός σου, καὶ λάβε σεαυτῷ ἐκεῖθεν γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Λάβαν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρός σου.

verses.geez: ወአምላኪየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወያዐቢየከ ፡ ወይባርክ ፡ ወያበዝኅከ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ብዙኀ ፡ አሕዛበ ።
verses.translation: And may my God bless thee, and increase thee, and multiply thee, and thou shalt become gatherings of nations.

translations.lxx: And may my God bless thee, and increase thee, and multiply thee, and thou shalt become gatherings of nations.
translations.kjv: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;
translations.ron: Şi Dumnezeul cel Atotputernic să te binecuvânteze, să te crească şi să te înmulţească şi să lăsară din tine popoare multe;
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Θεός μου εὐλογήσαι σε, καὶ αὐξήσαι σε, καὶ πληθύναι σε· καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይሁበከ ፡ በረከተ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ አቡከ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትረሳ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ
                  ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ ለአብርሃም ።
verses.translation: And may he give thee the blessing of my father Abraam, even to thee and to thy seed after thee, to inherit the land of thy sojourning, which God gave to Abraam.

translations.lxx: And may he give thee the blessing of my father Abraam, even to thee and to thy seed after thee, to inherit the land of thy sojourning, which God gave to Abraam.
translations.kjv: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.
translations.ron: Să-ţi dea binecuvântarea lui Avraam, tatăl meu, ţie şi urmaşilor tăi ca să stăpâneşti pământul ce-l locuieşti acum şi pe care l-a dat Dumnezeu lui Avraam,
translations.grk: Καὶ δῴη σοι τὴν εὐλόγιαν Ἁβραὰμ τοῦ πατρός μου, σοὶ καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σὲ, κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν τῆς παροικήσεώς σου, ἣν ἔδωκεν ὁ Θεὸς τῷ Ἁβραάμ.

verses.geez:
ወፈነዎ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ዘሶርያ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ላባ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ባቱኤል ፡ ሶርያዊ ፡
                  እኁሃ ፡ ለርብቃ ።
verses.translation: So Isaac sent away Jacob, and he went into Mesopotamia to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca the mother of Jacob and Esau.

translations.lxx: So Isaac sent away Jacob, and he went into Mesopotamia to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca the mother of Jacob and Esau.
translations.kjv: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padanaram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
translations.ron: Şi aşa Isaac i-a dat drumul lui Iacov, iar acesta s-a dus în Mesopotamia, la Laban, fiul lui Batuel Arameul şi fratele Rebecăi, mama lui Iacov şi a lui Isav.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακώβ· καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν πρὸς Λάβαν τὸν υἱὸν Βαθουὴλ τοῦ Σύρου, ἀδελφὸν Ῥεβέκκας τῆς μητρὸς Ἰακὼβ καὶ Ἡσαῦ.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ከመ ፡ ባረኮ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ዘሶርያ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንሣእ
                  ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እምህየ ፡ ዘባረከ ፡ ወአዘዞ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይንሣእ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እምህየ ፡ እምአዋልደ ፡ ከናአን ፤
verses.translation: And Esau saw that Isaac blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Mesopotamia of Syria as he blessed him, to take to himself a wife thence, and that he charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites;

translations.lxx: And Esau saw that Isaac blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Mesopotamia of Syria as he blessed him, to take to himself a wife thence, and that he charged him, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of the Chananites;
translations.kjv: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;
translations.ron: Văzând însă Isav că Isaac a binecuvântat pe Iacov şi l-a trimis în Mesopotamia, să-şi ia femeie de acolo, pentru care l-a binecuvântat şi i-a poruncit, zicând: "Să nu-ţi iei femeie din fetele Canaaneilor",
translations.grk: Ἴδε δὲ Ἡσαῦ ὅτι εὐλόγησεν Ἰσαὰκ τὸν Ἰακὼβ, καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας, λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκα ἐκεῖθεν, ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτόν· καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ, λέγων, οὐ λήψῃ γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων.

verses.geez: ወሰምዖሙ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወለእሙ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አፍላግ ፤
verses.translation: and that Jacob hearkened to his father and his mother, and went to Mesopotamia of Syria.

translations.lxx: and that Jacob hearkened to his father and his mother, and went to Mesopotamia of Syria.
translations.kjv: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram;
translations.ron: Şi că Iacov a ascultat pe tatăl său şi pe mama sa şi s-a dus în Mesopotamia,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσεν Ἰακὼβ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ዔሳው ፡ ከመ ፡ እኩያት ፡ እማንቱ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ከናአን ፡ በኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ይስሐቅ ፤
verses.translation: And Esau also having seen that the daughters of Chanaan were evil before his father Isaac,

translations.lxx: And Esau also having seen that the daughters of Chanaan were evil before his father Isaac,
translations.kjv: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;
translations.ron: Şi înţelegând Isav că lui Isaac, tatăl său; nu-i plac fetele Canaaneilor,
translations.grk: Ἰδὼν δὲ καὶ Ἡσαῦ ὅτι πονηραί εἰσιν αἱ θυγατέρες Χαναὰν ἐναντίον Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez:
ሖረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይስማኤል ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ ለኤማሌት ፡ ወለተ ፡ ይስማኤል ፡ ወልደ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለናኮር ፡ ከመ ፡
                  ትኩኖ ፡ ብእሲቶ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አንስቲያሁ ።
verses.translation: Esau went to Ismael, and took Maeleth the daughter of Ismael, the son of Abraam, the sister of Nabeoth, a wife in addition to his other wives.

translations.lxx: Esau went to Ismael, and took Maeleth the daughter of Ismael, the son of Abraam, the sister of Nabeoth, a wife in addition to his other wives.
translations.kjv: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.
translations.ron: S-a dus la Ismael şi, pe lângă cele două femei ale sale, şi-a mai luat şi pe Mahalat, fata lui Ismael, fiul lui Avraam, şi sora lui Nebaiot.
translations.grk: ἐπορεύθη Ἡσαῦ πρὸς Ἰσμαήλ· καὶ ἔλαβε τὴν Μαελὲθ, θυγατέρα Ἰσμαὴλ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ἁβραὰμ, ἀδελφὴν Ναβεὼθ, πρὸς ταῖς γυναιξὶν αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα.

verses.geez: ወወፅአ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዐዘቅተ ፡ መሐላ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ካራን ።
verses.translation: And Jacob went forth from the well of the oath, and departed into Charrhan.

translations.lxx: And Jacob went forth from the well of the oath, and departed into Charrhan.
translations.kjv: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
translations.ron: Iar Iacov ieşind din Beer-Şeba, s-a dus în Haran.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ἰακὼβ ἀπὸ τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ ὅρκου, καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Χαῤῥάν.

verses.geez:
[ወረከበ ፡ መካነ ፡] ወቤተ ፡ ህየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ዐረበት ፡ ፀሓይ ፡ ወነሥአ ፡ እምውእቱ ፡ እብን ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ብሔር ፡
                  ወወደየ ፡ ትርኣሲሁ ፡ ወቤተ ፡ ህየ ።
verses.translation: And came to a certain place and slept there, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it at his head, and lay down to sleep in that place,

translations.lxx: And came to a certain place and slept there, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones of the place, and put it at his head, and lay down to sleep in that place,
translations.kjv: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.
translations.ron: Ajungând însă la un loc, a rămas să doarmă acolo, căci asfinţise soarele. Şi luând una din pietrele locului aceluia şi punându-şi-o căpătâi, s-a culcat în locul acela.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπήντησε τόπῳ, καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ, ἔδυ γὰρ ὁ ἥλιος· καὶ ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τῶν λίθων τοῦ τόπου, καὶ ἔθηκε πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ἐκείνῳ.

verses.geez:
ወሐለመ ፡ ወይሬኢ ፡ ሰዋስወ ፡ (ዘወርቅ ፡) ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወርእሱ ፡ ያሰምክ ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወመላእክተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር
                  ፡ የዐርጉ ፡ ወይወርዱ ፡ ቦቱ ።
verses.translation: and dreamed, and behold a ladder fixed on the earth, whose top reached to heaven, and the angels of God ascended and descended on it.

translations.lxx: and dreamed, and behold a ladder fixed on the earth, whose top reached to heaven, and the angels of God ascended and descended on it.
translations.kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
translations.ron: Şi a visat că era o scară, sprijinită pe pământ, iar cu vârful atingea cerul; iar îngerii lui Dumnezeu se suiau şi se pogorau pe ea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνυπνιάσθη· καὶ ἰδοὺ κλίμαξ ἐστηριγμένη ἐν τῇ γῇ, ἧς ἡ κεφαλὴ ἀφικνεῖτο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν· καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνέβαινον καὶ κατέβαινον ἐπʼ αὐτῇ.

verses.geez:
ወእግዚእ ፡ ያሰምክ ፡ በላዕሌሁ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ አነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወአምላከ ፡ ይስሐቅ
                  ፡ አቡከ ፡ ኢትፍራህ ፡ ዛቲኒ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ትሰክብ ፡ ለከ ፡ እሁበከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord stood upon it, and said, I am the God of thy father Abraam, and the God of Isaac; fear not, the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.

translations.lxx: And the Lord stood upon it, and said, I am the God of thy father Abraam, and the God of Isaac; fear not, the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.
translations.kjv: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;
translations.ron: Apoi S-a arătat Domnul în capul scării şi i-a zis: "Eu sunt Domnul, Dumnezeul lui Avraam, tatăl tău, şi Dumnezeul lui Isaac. Nu te teme! Pământul pe care dormi ţi-l voi da ţie şi urmaşilor tăi.
translations.grk: Ὁ δὲ Κύριος ἐπεστήρικτο ἐπʼ αὐτῆς· καὶ εἶπεν, ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ Θεὸς Ἁβραὰμ τοῦ πατρός σου, καὶ ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσαάκ· μὴ φοβοῦ· ἡ γῆ ἐφʼ ἧς σὺ καθεύδεις ἐπʼ αὐτῆς, σοὶ δώσω αὐτὴν, καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου.

verses.geez:
ወይከውን ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይበዝኅ ፡ ዘርእከ ፡ ወይመልእ ፡ እስከ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አዜብ ፡
                  ወመስዕ ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ወይትባረክ ፡ በእንቲአከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወበዘርእከ ።
verses.translation: And thy seed shall be as the sand of the earth; and it shall spread abroad to the sea, and the south, and the north, and to the east; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.

translations.lxx: And thy seed shall be as the sand of the earth; and it shall spread abroad to the sea, and the south, and the north, and to the east; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.
translations.kjv: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
translations.ron: Urmaşii tăi vor fi mulţi ca pulberea pământului şi tu te vei întinde la apus şi la răsărit, la miazănoapte şi la miazăzi, şi se vor binecuvânta întru tine şi întru urmaşii tăi toate neamurile pământului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς γῆς, καὶ πλατυνθήσεται ἐπὶ θάλασσαν, καὶ Λίβα, καὶ Βοῤῥὰν, καὶ ἐπὶ ἀνατολάς· καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου.

verses.geez:
ወአነ ፡ አሐውር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ወአዐቅበከ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ፍኖትከ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ወኣገብአከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዝክቱ ፡ ምድር
                  ፡ ወኢየኀድገከ ፡ እስከ ፡ እገብር ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘእቤለከ ።
verses.translation: And behold I am with thee to preserve thee continually in all the way wherein thou shalt go; and I will bring thee back to this land; for I will not desert thee, until I have done all that I have said to thee.

translations.lxx: And behold I am with thee to preserve thee continually in all the way wherein thou shalt go; and I will bring thee back to this land; for I will not desert thee, until I have done all that I have said to thee.
translations.kjv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
translations.ron: Iată, Eu sunt cu tine şi te voi păzi în orice cale vei merge; te voi întoarce în pământul acesta şi nu te voi lăsa până nu voi împlini toate câte ţi-am spus".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι μετὰ σοῦ, διαφυλάσσων σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πάσῃ, οὗ ἂν πορευθῇς· καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην· ὅτι οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω, ἕως τοῦ ποιῆσαί με πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησά σοι.

verses.geez: ወነቅሀ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ እምንዋሙ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወአንሰ ፡ ኢያእመርኩ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and said, The Lord is in this place, and I knew it not.

translations.lxx: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and said, The Lord is in this place, and I knew it not.
translations.kjv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
translations.ron: Iar când s-a deşteptat din somnul său, Iacov a zis: "Domnul este cu adevărat în locul acesta şi eu n-am ştiut!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξηγέρθη Ἰακὼβ ἐκ τοῦ ὕπνου αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν, ὅτι ἔστι Κύριος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ, ἐγὼ δὲ οὐκ ᾔδειν.

verses.geez:
ወፈርሀ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ግሩም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ዝየ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወዛቲ ፡ ኆኅታ ፡
                  ይእቲ ፡ ለሰማይ ።
verses.translation: And he was afraid, and said, How fearful is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

translations.lxx: And he was afraid, and said, How fearful is this place! this is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
translations.kjv: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
translations.ron: Şi, spăimântându-se Iacov, a zis: "Cât de înfricoşător este locul acesta! Aceasta nu e alta fără numai casa lui Dumnezeu, aceasta e poarta cerului!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐφοβήθη, καὶ εἶπεν, ὡς φοβερὸς ὁ τόπος οὗτος· οὐκ ἔστι τοῦτο ἀλλʼ ἢ οἶκος Θεοῦ, καὶ αὕτη ἡ πύλη τοῦ οὐρανοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወተንሥአ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ በጽባሕ ፡ ወነሥኣ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ እብን ፡ እንተ ፡ ወደያ ፡ ትርኣሲሁ ፡ ወአቀማ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሐውልት
                  ፡ ወሶጠ ፡ ቅብአ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ርእሳ ።
verses.translation: And Jacob rose up in the morning, and took the stone he had laid there by his head, and he set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

translations.lxx: And Jacob rose up in the morning, and took the stone he had laid there by his head, and he set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.
translations.kjv: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
translations.ron: Apoi s-a sculat Iacov dis-de-dimineaţă, a luat piatra ce şi-o pusese căpătâi, a pus-o stâlp şi a turnat pe vârful ei untdelemn.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέστη Ἰακὼβ τὸ πρωῒ, καὶ ἔλαβε τὸν λίθον, ὃν ὑπέθηκεν ἐκεῖ πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν στήλην, καὶ ἐπέχεεν ἔλαιον ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ወሰመየ ፡ ስሞ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወስሙሰ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ትካቲሁ ፡ ውለምሕሳ ።
verses.translation: And he called the name of that place, the House of God; and the name of the city before was Ulam-luz.

translations.lxx: And he called the name of that place, the House of God; and the name of the city before was Ulam-luz.
translations.kjv: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.
translations.ron: Iacov a pus locului aceluia numele Betel (casa lui Dumnezeu), căci mai înainte cetatea aceea se numea Luz.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου, οἶκος Θεοῦ· καὶ Οὐλαμλοὺζ ἦν ὄνομα τῇ πόλει τὸ πρότερον.

verses.geez:
ወበፅአ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስሌየ ፡ ወዐቀበኒ ፡ በዛቲ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ
                  ፡ አሐውር ፡ ወወሀበኒ ፡ እክለ ፡ ዘእሴሰይ ፡ ወልብሰ ፡ ዘእለብስ ፤
verses.translation: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If the Lord God will be with me, and guard me throughout on this journey, on which I am going, and give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

translations.lxx: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If the Lord God will be with me, and guard me throughout on this journey, on which I am going, and give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
translations.kjv: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
translations.ron: Şi a făcut Iacov făgăduinţă, zicând: "De va fi Domnul Dumnezeu cu mine şi mă va povăţui în calea aceasta, în care merg eu astăzi, de-mi va da pâine să mănânc şi haine să mă îmbrac;
translations.grk: Καὶ ηὔξατο Ἰακὼβ εὐχὴν, λέγων, ἐὰν ᾖ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς μετʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ διαφυλάξῃ με ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ταύτῃ, ᾗ ἐγὼ πορεύομαι, καὶ δῷ μοι ἄρτον φαγεῖν, καὶ ἱμάτιον περιβαλέσθαι,

verses.geez: ወአግብአኒ ፡ በዳኅን ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወይከውነኒ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኪየ ።
verses.translation: and bring me back in safety to the house of my father, then shall the Lord be for a God to me.

translations.lxx: and bring me back in safety to the house of my father, then shall the Lord be for a God to me.
translations.kjv: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:
translations.ron: Şi de mă voi întoarce sănătos la casa tatălui meu, atunci Domnul va fi Dumnezeul meu.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀποστρέψῃ με μετὰ σωτηρίας εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ ἔσται Κύριός μοι εἰς Θεόν.

verses.geez:
ወዛቲ ፡ እብን ፡ እንተ ፡ አቀምኩ ፡ ትከውነኒ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘወሀበኒ ፡ ዓሥራተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ እዔሥሮ
                  ፡ ለከ ።
verses.translation: And this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be to me a house of God; and of all whatsoever thou shalt give me, I will tithe a tenth for thee.

translations.lxx: And this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be to me a house of God; and of all whatsoever thou shalt give me, I will tithe a tenth for thee.
translations.kjv: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.
translations.ron: Iar piatra aceasta, pe care am pus-o stâlp, va fi pentru mine casa lui Dumnezeu şi din toate câte-mi vei da Tu mie, a zecea parte o voi da Ţie".
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ λίθος οὗτος, ὃν ἔστησα στήλην, ἔσται μοι οἶκος Θεοῦ· καὶ πάντων ὧν ἐάν μοι δῷς, δεκάτην ἀποδεκατώσω αὐτά σοι.
